objective:
Goal: the article's print and export options are shown. Reach it from the current page by clicking through the visible UI, by any route. Never type a URL or use the address bar.
Hint: an old tutorial said "To do this, click the Print/export link on the left sidebar in Wikipedia when you're on an article you want to save.", but those labels may have moved or been renamed.
When the goal is met, verify it on screen. If the page you end on has a main heading, store it as 'landed_on'; a page without a heading is fine.

actions.intent: PRIMARY: article's print and export options; role=button; text="Tools" | HINTS: container=Page tools navigation near article tabs
actions.instr: Clicking print and export tools in the article toolbar

actions.intent: whether the article's print and export options is present (in the page tools navigation)
actions.instr: Checking whether the article print and export options are shown

actions.intent: whether the page you end on main heading is present (in the article main content)
actions.instr: Checking whether the page main heading is present
If-else checkpoint cp_2: condition 'the page you end on has a main heading' matched
Get the main heading from the page you end on and save as {{landed_on}}

actions.intent: the main heading of the current page
actions.instr: Reading the current page main heading
Get the main heading from the page you end on and save as {{landed_on}}
